scripts.start:prod: pnpm run build && dotenv -e .env.api -- pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run start
scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "dotenv -e .env.api -- pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run dev" "dotenv -e .env.web -- wait-on http://localhost:8080/api/healthz && dotenv -e .env.web -- pnpm --filter @workspace/gestion run dev"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
